descent_no_go.isotropy: J restricted to Lambda x Lambda is zero
descent_no_go.descent_requirement: for J to define a form on P/Lambda, J(lambda,p)=0 for every lambda in Lambda and p in P, i.e. Lambda must lie in rad(J)
descent_no_go.failure: J is nondegenerate, so rad(J)=0 while Lambda is nonzero
descent_no_go.maximal_lagrangian: Lambda^perp_J=Lambda; the symplectic/Krein reduction Lambda^perp/Lambda is therefore zero
descent_no_go.conclusion: the nontrivial defect quotient carries no canonical inherited Green form

categorical_correction.wrong: put a positive Hermitian filler directly on the sewing quotient D
categorical_correction.right: retain the extension/mapping-cone object Lambda -> P -> D together with the shifted dual boundary pairing
categorical_correction.needed_extra: a source-derived complementary Lagrangian Lambda' or equivalent splitting/polarization pairing D with Lambda

C4_role.candidate: a quarter-turn transports Lambda to Lambda_1=F Lambda; if Lambda and Lambda_1 are transverse, Lambda_1 supplies the missing complement
C4_role.cycle: Lambda_j=F^j Lambda for j in Z/4, with Tate/metaplectic cocycle retained
C4_role.required_law: each consecutive pair is a typed hyperbolic/Lagrangian pair and the induced complement identifications satisfy fourfold coherence
C4_role.positive_form_candidate: the Maslov/crossing form obtained from the ordered pair (Lambda_j,Lambda_(j+1)), not the quotient form of Lambda_j alone
C4_role.warning: transversality and sign of this crossing form are not consequences of F^4=I or endpoint maximal isotropy

Evans_interpretation.Xi: tau=0 means the reactive line meets the dark/sewing Lagrangian
Evans_interpretation.absolute_residual: the Hilbert residual measures pairing with a complementary direction and therefore need not vanish merely because the state lies on the Lagrangian intersection
Evans_interpretation.confinement_gate: show the C4/Tate-selected crossing form is positive off seam and that its relative boundary on the Evans mapping cone is tau-divisible

next_exact_test: Construct Lambda_1=F Lambda using the admitted response quarter-turn; compute Lambda cap Lambda_1 and the operator-valued crossing Gram J(lambda,F mu). A nontrivial kernel or an indefinite finite packet rejects the C4-selected positive-complement route.
conclusion: The missing categorical datum is indeed tied to quotient change, but the quotient alone cannot carry the Green metric. A maximal-isotropic sewing graph has zero reduction and is not a radical. Positivity can only come from the ordered relation between successive C4-transported Lagrangians—a Maslov/crossing-form coherencer around the four-cycle.
